desc: Derive the cut-penalty transformation reducing `k*i*segCost` to `k*C_total + k*sum_cuts suffixCost(after cut)`; exact recurrence documented.
Build 1-indexed prefix sums A (nums) and B (cost) with sentinel at index 0.
Implement the O(n^2) DP `dp[j]` in `Solution.minimumCost`, with no cut penalty for the first segment and final `+ k*B[n]` constant.
Verify Example 1 = 110 (dp=[0,12,40,94], +16) and Example 2 = 985; logic hand-checked.
Edge case n=1 reduces to `(nums[0]+k)*cost[0]`, matching the single-segment formula.
Complexity confirmed O(n^2) time / O(n) space; n<=1000 so CHT/Li Chao/Monge optimization unnecessary.
